description: Replying to @Jelly  hands down the best brown butter cookie recipe, soft chewy gooey centre with crinkly crispy corners ⭐️ ingredients (yields ~8 cookies): 127g butter 120g light brown sugar 55g granulated sugar 1tbsp heavy cream 1tsp vanilla extract 1 egg 170g flour 2.5g baking soda pinch of salt 150g chopped dark & milk choc
transcript: You guys have all been asking so I'm finally sharing the recipe to my viral brown butter cookie. This is quite literally the best and only recipe would ever need and will absolutely change your life so let's make it together. I'm just going to start off by browning our butter just constantly stirring until it turns into this beautiful golden colour and smells all nutty and delicious and we're then going to transfer it into a separate bowl and let it cool down for about 15 minutes and you can use that time to disassemble the rest of your ingredients and then we're going to head and mix some castor sugar and some light brown sugar. I'm going to leave all the exact measurements in the description below. I'm just going to add that onto the cooled butter and whisk away until the sugar is fully dissolved. We're then going to add one egg, some vanilla extract and some double cream and continue whisking until it turns into this beautiful light brown caramely colour and smells really nice and delicious but make sure you whisk really well for about two minutes until the sugar is completely dissolved and you can't feel it anymore. We're then going to go ahead and add in our flour, baking soda and salt mixture. Just until combined please don't over mix this otherwise you'll end up with really dense and dry cookies which we don't really want. We're then going to fold in your chocolate of choice. I personally like to go for majority dark chocolate and then a little bit of milk chocolate and semi-sweet chocolate chips and make sure to chop it up so you get those gooey melty pools of chocolate in your cookie. We're then going to go ahead and roll them into equal balls. I like mine to weigh around 90 grams each. Put them in the freezer for 10 minutes and then the oven for 10 minutes. The secret to these crinkly chewy cookies with a crispy edge and a gooey centre is that you're going to want to slam the tray about five times as soon as you take out the oven and we're then going to put it back in for another three minutes in the oven and then lay them rest in room temperature for about five minutes before serving. Sprinkle some sea salt on top and you can serve it either on its own or on top of some delicious vanilla ice cream and thank me later.
